ns0:text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 21px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #17364a

ns0:g.ns0:text: D04 Which analysis methods accompany each uncertainty source?

ns0:text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526676

ns0:g.ns0:text: Computed same-paper, same-context associations. Bubble area = assessment count; colour = share of that source’s assessments.

ns0:text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526676

ns0:g.ns0:text: Only codes within the identical publication and boundary are joined. Multiple sources/methods can occur in one assessment; cells are not additive.

ns0:text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526676

ns0:g.ns0:text: The labels describe sources, not automatically epistemic/aleatory categories. A method association does not prove uncertainty transfer.

ns0:text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526676

ns0:g.ns0:text: Zero is no recorded association in this extraction; N is the number of assessed contexts carrying that source. All edges and supporting IDs are exported.
